messages:
lily: Quick check — RFC review Wednesday 11:00 PT. Need to slot three authors: @maria (model routing), @sam (runtime batching), @jordan (kv/cache optim). Who can review and any ordering preferences? Prefer short pre-reads (<= 2 pages).

maria: I can present first. Pre-read will be ~1.5 pages + a short diagram. EOD Mon for pre-read link works for me.

sam: I'm around. Prefer to go second if possible — I have a morning heads-down Friday. Will push a tiny CI fix today.

jordan: Can I swap to last? Travel Wed morning, better to present toward the end. Will need a reviewer to pair on the demo.

alex: I can review @maria. Also ok to take pair-review for @jordan demo if someone else takes @sam.

lily: Thanks — tentative order: maria, sam, jordan. @alex pairs with jordan for demo. @sam, can you confirm ci fix ETA?

sam: Fix in PR #482 — should merge by EOD today. Won't affect the demo code, just test flakes.

maria: Uploaded pre-read draft here: https://company.docs/rfcs/2026/model-routing-preread (comments open). Please highlight any questions inline :thumbsup:

lily: Calendar invite created and sent. Agenda snippet:
```
11:00 — 5m intro
11:05 — 12m @maria (pre-read Q&A)
11:17 — 12m @sam (runtime batch + perf)
11:29 — 12m @jordan (kv/cache demo)
11:41 — 10m open discussion & follow-ups
```
Please keep slides to a single deck slide per author.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite posted: RFC Review — Wed 11:00 PT. See channel for updated attendee list.

alex: Small ask — can we call out any must-have reviewers? I'll make sure to be there for maria. @lily, do we want to tag infra/security for the routing RFC?

lily: Good call. Adding @security for a quick 5m check in the follow-up. Also reminder: pre-reads due EOD Mon. I'll ping again Mon morning.

jordan: Thanks all. I'll record a 3-min demo clip and drop into the thread before the meeting.

maria: Thanks — will tag sections in the doc for review focus areas.

lily: Awesome. Closing loop: reviewers = alex (maria), jordan paired with alex for demo, sam self-reviewed + asking @devx for quick perf sanity. See you Wed :raised_hands:
